### The Integrity of Job
Author: Bible Pathway
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/the-integrity-of-job-bible-study-minute-july-20-2017.html
Passage: Job 27:5-6
Points:
- Job refused to use his intense suffering as an excuse to turn toward sin.
- He rejected his friends' false accusations and refused to compromise his testimony to satisfy them.
- Maintaining upright character and keeping one's word is increasingly rare but vital in modern society.
- Even minor dishonesty or small compromises ultimately erode spiritual integrity and harm character.
- God provides the necessary strength to remain faithful and blameless during seasons of testing.
